title: Agent Operating Contract Machine Projection
migration_phase: PHASE-5-target-overdue-needs-replan; docs/AGENTS.md remains operating contract until explicit promotion evidence
purpose: Machine-readable projection of the agent operating contract so root-hub discovery can point to the future PHASE-5 JSON target without prematurely demoting docs/AGENTS.md authority.

authority_boundary.projection_use: Discovery, validation planning, and migration readiness only
authority_boundary.not_allowed: Do not cite this projection as superseding docs/AGENTS.md until PHASE-5 promotion lands with authority-cohesion evidence.

required_sequence: read docs/AGENTS.md for the live operating contract
use plain git on an isolated worktree branch for edits
verify with the smallest evidence loop that proves the completion claim
open a protected PR against dev
merge only after the PR is fully reviewed, review threads are resolved, the single protected presubmit context is green, no merge conflict exists, and branch protection is satisfied

agent_completion_contract.must_continue_until: requested local branch is implemented or a concrete blocker is documented
must_not_do: ask for permission on safe reversible next steps
modify individual ADR files during index-only gardening
modify individual microservice, persona, or journey files during hub README gardening
evidence_required: protected PR verification, reviewer approval, presubmit evidence, or explicit blocker

coordinator_worker_split.coordinator_role: The capability-neutral portfolio/architecture coordinator evaluates architecture, system design, completed and upcoming work, maturity gaps, documentation/procedure/process health, regressions, and work-item decomposition/prioritization.
coordinator_worker_split.worker_role: Dispatcher-assigned implementation and review workers execute scoped lane edits, tests, review, and PR evidence in isolated worktrees.
coordinator_worker_split.boundary: The coordinator is not the default implementation worker unless explicitly assigned as that lane worker.
coordinator_worker_split.blocker_policy: Coordinator-discovered blockers become dispatcher-ready resolution cards with source context, blocker class, acceptance criteria, verification path, suggested owner/profile, and dependency/conflict notes unless the coordinator is explicitly assigned as worker.
coordinator_worker_split.autonomous_merge_boundary: Autonomous merge authority requires a fully reviewed PR, resolved review threads, required presubmit context green, no merge conflict, and branch protection satisfied.

hyperscaler_grade_rigor.named_precedent: Google-style mono-repo agent operating contract plus Kubernetes-style admission gates: a readable policy source with machine-checkable admission transitions.

failure_modes.behavior: root guidance remains discoverable through README/CLAUDE/AGENTS pointers and protected PR gates reject unverified edits when policy is enforced
projection is non-authoritative until PHASE-5 and must be reconciled before promotion
isolated worktree branches, protected PR review, and presubmit admission evidence record scope before promotion

hyperscaler_grade_rigor.rollback_path: Revert this projection or reset root-hub pointer fields while keeping docs/AGENTS.md as current authority.
hyperscaler_grade_rigor.versioning: Schema-compatible additive changes until PHASE-5; breaking authority promotion requires ADR/update evidence.
